overlayEntry.notes: sUSN is Noon's ERC-4626 staking wrapper over USN and inherits the shared Noon reserve pool; this review shares the usn-noon 2026-07-27 capture of the Accountable-operated dashboard API (fetched 22:52:08Z and 22:54:31Z; data timestamp 2026-07-27T22:45:43.224Z): reserves $34,400,188.21 against USN supply 33,932,393.29 (collateralization 1.013786), deployed 71.18% Fasanara FTAC private credit, 10.24% DeFi lending, 7.99% US Treasury bills, 5.23% JAAA CLOs, 5.36% Other. The same payload publishes the sUSN NAV at 1.2107203362158603 USN per sUSN. weightedAverageMaturityDays is unavailable for the same reason as the parent: the API payload and Noon's transparency and liquidity docs publish no position-level maturities, maturity ladder, or portfolio WAM for the underlying pool, and deriving one from liquidity windows would be prohibited extrapolation. valuationCadenceDays is measured at 0.0105 from the two consecutive signed attestation snapshots (22:30:40.217Z and 22:45:43.200Z) on the self-described live feed that also carries the sUSN NAV. valuationCadence is adequate: the sUSN exchange rate is continuously republished by Accountable's independently operated, custodian-direct verification feed with signed snapshot, ZKP, and Merkle-root attestations. creditQuality is limited (inherited): category-level composition is third-party-verified, but FTAC borrowers, DeFi positions, and the Other bucket are undisclosed. seniority is limited and genuinely wrapper-specific: Noon documents sUSN as the residual yield tranche - fully backed by USN in the staking vault, receiving 80% of raw protocol returns minted into the vault daily while base USN receives no raw yield - but no public document fixes the loss-allocation waterfall between USN and sUSN when reserves fall below supply. custody is limited: the wrapper itself is an on-chain Ethereum ERC-4626 vault (verified source, 48-hour timelock governance, reads at block 25530817 on 2026-07-14) holding USN, with the upstream pool custodied at the Accountable-reported venues (Fasanara 71.18%, Safe 15.26%, Alpaca 13.22%, ForDefi 0.35%); custodian legal terms remain undisclosed. maturityAndLiquidity is limited: sUSN inherits the documented T+5 full-liquidity commitment and 20%/60%/100% waterfall, and unstaking is documented as subject to a cooldown period whose duration is not stated. recovery is limited: the shared feed reports $1,570,997.42 of insurance cover (4.63% of USN supply, insurance NFT 4969) but cover terms and any recapitalization obligation are undisclosed. legalEnforceability is left bounded: no prospectus, regulatory filing, or enforceable public holder terms were located.

weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: The metric applies to the inherited USN reserve pool (71.18% private credit with a documented T+3-month redemption window) but no measurable value is published. Searched the full Accountable dashboard API payload (deployment buckets, custody split, timeline, attestation bundle; no maturity fields), Noon's transparency and liquidity documentation (per-strategy liquidity windows only), and the USN/sUSN product docs. No position-level maturity dates, maturity ladder, or portfolio weighted-average maturity is disclosed; the disclosure should live in the Accountable dashboard's position-level reserve detail.

evidenceSummary: Shared the usn-noon capture of the Accountable Noon proof-of-solvency API (fetched 2026-07-27T22:52:08Z and ~22:54:31Z; data timestamp 22:45:43.224Z). sUSN-specific observation: the same live payload publishes the sUSN NAV at 1.2107203362158603 USN per sUSN. Noon docs establish sUSN as the residual yield tranche (80% of raw returns, fully backed by USN in the Ethereum ERC-4626 vault 0xe24a3dc889621612422a64e6388927901608b91d, unstaking subject to an unstated-duration cooldown). Metrics: valuationCadenceDays measured 0.0105 (signed snapshots 22:30:40.217Z and 22:45:43.200Z); weightedAverageMaturityDays unavailable (no maturity disclosure anywhere in the payload or docs).
